title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase by contacting support with their order number. After 30 days refunds are not available, but unused months of an annual plan can be credited toward a future renewal. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7 business days.

title: Password reset
text: Use the self-service portal to reset a forgotten password. The reset link is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once. After 5 failed login attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. If the link has expired, request a new one from the sign-in page.

title: Error E4021
text: Error E4021 means the upload exceeded the 25 MB attachment limit. Compress the file or split it into smaller parts and try again. Images can usually be resized to fit. The limit applies to each attachment, not to the whole message.

title: VPN setup
text: Install the corporate VPN client and connect to the gateway at vpn.northwind.example on UDP port 51820. Sign in with your work account, then approve the multi-factor prompt. If the connection drops repeatedly, reinstall the client certificate from the IT portal.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Submit receipts in ExpenseHub within 30 days of the purchase. Your manager approves the request and payment follows within 10 business days. Meals are capped at 40 dollars per day. Alcohol and personal items are not reimbursable.

title: On-call rotation
text: Engineers share a weekly on-call rotation with handoff every Monday at 10:00. The primary must acknowledge a page within 5 minutes; unacknowledged pages escalate to the secondary after 15 minutes. On-call weeks earn compensation time off, taken within the following month.

title: Data retention
text: Application logs are kept for 90 days and database backups for 35 days. Customer data is deleted 30 days after an account is closed. A legal hold suspends deletion for the data it covers until the hold is lifted by the legal team.

title: Release process
text: Releases ship on Tuesdays with a code freeze on Monday at 18:00. Each release first goes to a canary receiving 10 percent of traffic for one hour. If the error rate rises above 2 percent the release is rolled back automatically and the owner is paged.

title: Security incident response
text: Report any suspected security incident in the security channel within 1 hour. Incidents are rated SEV1 to SEV3 by impact. The responder contains the issue first, then investigates, and a written postmortem is due within 5 working days.

title: Parental leave
text: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks. Leave can be taken any time within 12 months of the birth or adoption and may be split into two blocks with manager agreement.

title: Laptop replacement
text: Company laptops are replaced every 3 years. A broken laptop is swapped within 2 business days through the IT helpdesk. If a laptop is lost or stolen, report it to IT immediately so the device can be locked and wiped.

title: API rate limits
text: Each API key may make 600 requests per minute. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header telling the client how many seconds to wait. Short bursts are tolerated. Enterprise plans can request higher limits.

title: Home office stipend
text: Eligible employees receive a one-time home office stipend of 500 dollars each year to buy a desk, chair or monitor. Claim it through ExpenseHub with the receipt. Unused stipend does not carry over to the next year.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: All accounts require two-factor authentication using an authenticator app. Save your backup codes when you enrol. If your phone is lost or replaced, use a backup code to sign in, then enrol the new device; if you have no codes, IT can verify your identity and reset the factor.
